sentences.text:
Heard on I.A No.7031/2023 which is first application under Section 389 (1) of the Cr.P.C filed on
behalf of appellant No.1 Jagdish Tanwar, S/o Jagganath Tanwar for grant of suspension of sentence.

The appellant has been convicted under Section 376 DB of the IPC and sentenced to undergo Life Imprisonment with fine of Rs. 5000/- and in case of default four months further RI and Section 6 read with Section 5 (m) and Section 6 read with Section 5 (g) of POCSO Act, 2012 and has been sentenced to life imprisonment for the remainder of the appellant accused natural life.
This application has been preferred on the ground that the trial Court erred in law in not considering the FIR as well as the statement recorded by the police.
The name of the appellant No.1 Jagdish is not present and there is no allegation against the appellant No.1 Jagdish that he committed rape on the person of prosecutrix.
It is also raised that the name of the appellant No.1 Jagdish is implicated due to rivalry between the appellant and the complainant.
The trial Court has erred in law in not considering the defense of the appellant accused.

The Government Advocate on the other hand opposed the prayer by filing the document No. 1723 of 2024 and stated that the appellant accused has been convicted for committing gang rape on a child below twelve years of the age.
The trial Court after due appreciation of the evidence has convicted the appellant hence, the application be dismissed.
We have heard both the parties and gone through the record of the trial Court.

The medical examination of the victim (PW-1) in the form of Exhibit-P- 6 affirms that an act of penetrating sexual assault was committed on the person of the prosecutrix and DNA finger printing report Exhibit-P-42 affirms the direct involvement of the co-appellant- Indersingh in the act and looking to definition of gang rape and the role of the appellant accused Jagdish described by the victim (PW-1)
in her statement, we are not inclined to allow the application for suspension of the appellant No.1 Jagdish, at present.
